slogan.en: One CLI unifies development, builds, testing, linting, and formatting across all your JavaScript projects. Powered by the Rspack ecosystem.
slogan.zh: 只需一个 CLI，即可统一所有 JavaScript 项目的开发、构建、测试、代码检查与格式化。由 Rspack 生态驱动。

appCommandTitle.zh: 从开发到构建，快人一步

appCommandDesc.en: Powered by Rspack and Rsbuild, start a dev server quickly and build enterprise-grade web applications
appCommandDesc.zh: 基于 Rspack 和 Rsbuild，快速启动开发服务器，构建企业级 Web 应用

appCommandHmr.zh: 构建速度比 webpack 快 5–20 倍

appCommandProduction.en: Built-in production optimizations for leaner bundles
appCommandProduction.zh: 内置多项生产优化能力，生成精简的产物

appCommandConfig.en: A consistent bundling process for development and production
appCommandConfig.zh: 开发与生产采用一致的打包流程

libCommandDesc.en: Build reusable JavaScript libraries with Rslib, with the flexibility to develop shared libraries, CLI tools, and components
libCommandDesc.zh: 使用 Rslib 构建可复用的 JavaScript 库，灵活应对公共库、命令行和组件开发需求

libCommandFormats.en: One configuration for ESM, CJS, Module Federation, and more
libCommandFormats.zh: 一份配置，输出 ESM、CJS 和模块联邦等多种格式

libCommandModes.en: Choose bundle or bundleless output to suit your needs
libCommandModes.zh: 按需选择 bundle 或 bundleless 输出模式

libCommandTypes.en: Generate type declarations quickly with TypeScript 7
libCommandTypes.zh: 使用 TypeScript 7 快速生成类型声明

testCommandDesc.en: Test JavaScript with Rstest for fast feedback from local development to CI
testCommandDesc.zh: 使用 Rstest 测试 JavaScript 代码，从本地开发到 CI 保持高效反馈

testCommandConfig.en: Automatically reuse existing build configuration to reduce maintenance
testCommandConfig.zh: 自动复用已有构建配置，减少维护成本

testCommandPerformance.en: Rspack-powered tests, over 20% faster than Jest
testCommandPerformance.zh: 由 Rspack 加速测试，比 Jest 快 20% 以上

checkCommandTitle.zh: 一个命令，保持代码一致

checkCommandDesc.en: Unify linting and formatting checks while keeping your Prettier options and plugins
checkCommandDesc.zh: 统一运行代码检查与格式校验，兼容 Prettier 选项与插件，延续团队代码规范

checkCommandTypes.en: Type-aware linting with optional TypeScript type checking
checkCommandTypes.zh: 支持类型感知规则，按需启用 TypeScript 类型检查

checkCommandFormat.en: Parallel formatting and persistent caching for faster repeat runs
checkCommandFormat.zh: 并行格式化与持久化缓存，加速重复检查

checkCommandFix.en: Fix lint and formatting issues with --fix
checkCommandFix.zh: 通过 --fix 自动修复代码与格式问题

hooksCommandTitle.zh: 让每次提交，都经过检查

hooksCommandDesc.en: Bring checks into your commit workflow, reuse lint-staged task configuration, and migrate existing Husky hooks
hooksCommandDesc.zh: 将代码检查融入提交流程，兼容 lint-staged 任务配置，支持迁移现有 Husky hooks

hooksCommandSetup.en: Manage repository-wide Git hooks in one place
hooksCommandSetup.zh: 统一管理仓库级 Git hooks

hooksCommandStaged.en: Check and format staged files before each commit
hooksCommandStaged.zh: 仅检查和格式化暂存文件，聚焦本次提交

hooksCommandTasks.en: Match files with glob patterns and run custom tasks
hooksCommandTasks.zh: 按文件模式匹配任务，灵活运行自定义命令

docCommandDesc.en: Build documentation sites with Rspress and maintain docs alongside your code
docCommandDesc.zh: 使用 Rspress 构建文档站点，让项目文档与代码一同开发和维护

docCommandMarkdown.en: Write Markdown and embed React components with MDX
docCommandMarkdown.zh: 支持 Markdown 与 MDX，灵活嵌入 React 组件

docCommandFeatures.zh: 内置全文搜索，支持多语言文档

docCommandWorkflow.en: One CLI for development, production builds, and local previews
docCommandWorkflow.zh: 统一完成文档开发、生产构建与本地预览
